cppDE

cppDE writes, compiles and runs a C++ solver for a system of ordinary differential equations given as equations in R, with the derivatives of the solution in the initial values and parameters, forward or reverse, to first and second order.

Features

  • Integrators: variable-order BDF/NDF and Adams in Nordsieck form, a Rosenbrock method of order 4 and the Tsitouras 5(4) Runge-Kutta pair, with dense or sparse (KLU) linear algebra
  • Forward sensitivities on dual numbers, gradients by a discrete adjoint at a cost independent of the parameter count, and exact Hessians forward over forward or forward over reverse
  • Time- and root-triggered events, switches and sliding, forcings, with sensitivities across every jump
  • Jacobians and derivative contractions by automatic differentiation on an expression graph, emitted as straight-line C++
  • The same models on SUNDIALS CVODES with cvode(), algebraic functions with cppFUN(), and batches of conditions solved in parallel
